First, note the given date is 09-09-1672 (likely DD-MM-YYYY).  
Subtract 249 days:  

1672 is a leap year (divisible by 4, not by 100).  
From 09-09-1672 back 9 days → 31-08-1672.  
Remaining 240 days back from 31-08-1672:  
August has 31 days, so back 31 days → 31-07-1672 (240 - 31 = 209 left).  
July has 31 days → back 31 days → 30-06-1672 (209 - 31 = 178 left).  
June has 30 days → back 30 days → 01-06-1672 (178 - 30 = 148 left).  
May has 31 days → back 31 days → 01-05-1672 (148 - 31 = 117 left).  
April has 30 days → back 30 days → 02-04-1672 (117 - 30 = 87 left).  
March has 31 days → back 31 days → 31-01-1672? Wait, March back 31 days from 02-04-1672 → 02-03-1672 (87 - 31 = 56 left).  
February 1672 has 29 days (leap year) → back 29 days → 02-02-1672 (56 - 29 = 27 left).  
January has 31 days → back 27 days → (31 - 27 = 4) → 04-01-1672.  

So 249 days before 09-09-1672 is 04-01-1672.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1672-01-04
